sourceTitle: Aam Panna Made with Green Mangoes
sourceText:
Aam Panna Made with Green Mangoes
By: sonia gupta
Published: Sunday, June 26, 2011 - 6:36pm

Ingredients




2 Raw Green Mangoes:
1/4 cup Sugar:
1 teaspoon Salt: or to taste
1/2 teaspoon Roasted Cumin Powder:
A few Sprigs of fresh Mint

Preparation

1 Wash and peel the mangoes, chop in to small chunks. 2 Boil in 1/2 cup of water till the chunks are soft and tender. 3 Let it cool down and blend it in a mixture to make a smooth puree. 4 Strain it through a sieve, if desired. 5 Add sugar, salt and cumin to taste. 6 Transfer the mango concentrate in a glass or stone ware bowl. 7 Prepare a drink by Putting 2 tsp of this concentrate in a glass and add water, mint leaves and ice. 8 Enjoy the fresh homemade drink to rejuvenate yourself.
